# shhh settings.
#
# Every setting is here, commented out at its default with the sentence that
# says what it decides above it. Uncomment a line to change one; a key left
# commented is a key nothing sets, which is not the same as a key written
# down at its zero.
#
# Two tables are not written here, because each has a command of its own:
# the MCP servers and the hooks.

[provider]

# Which provider a request goes to: a built-in one, or a gateway profile from
# `shhh providers`.
# --provider on the command line, then SHHH_PROVIDER in the environment,
# outrank this.
#default = "openai"

# The model a session runs on.
# The default is the provider's own default.
# --model on the command line, then SHHH_MODEL in the environment, outrank
# this.
#model = ""

# The provider key itself, which puts a copy of it in every copy of this file;
# `api_key_env` is the form to prefer.
# The default is from the environment.
# --api-key on the command line, then SHHH_API_KEY in the environment, outrank
# this.
#api_key = ""

# The environment variable the provider key is read from at start, so the file
# names the key instead of holding it. It is read ahead of `api_key`.
# The default is the provider's own variable.
#api_key_env = ""

# Where the provider's API is, for a gateway or a self-hosted endpoint.
# The default is the provider's own.
# SHHH_BASE_URL in the environment outranks this.
#base_url = ""

# What the provider is called on screen, for a gateway that fronts several.
# The default is the provider's own.
#name = ""

# How hard the model thinks before it answers; the level is fitted to each
# model, so a rung it lacks lowers to the one it has.
# --reasoning on the command line, then SHHH_REASONING in the environment,
# outrank this.
#reasoning = "medium"

# How long the opening a session repeats every round stays cached between
# rounds.
#cache_ttl = "1h"
